title: Transaction webhook response
description: What a payment app answers to TRANSACTION_INITIALIZE_SESSION and TRANSACTION_REFUND_REQUESTED. `amount` is a decimal in major units, as a number or a numeric string; left out, Core takes the amount it asked for. `pspReference` is required for CHARGE_SUCCESS. An answer Core cannot use is recorded as a failure.

message.description: Shown to staff on the transaction; at most 512 characters are kept.

data.description: Returned to the caller of transactionInitialize as `data`.
